phases.name: Learn
phases.milestone: Pass the internal product certification and shadow at least 6 customer calls.

phases.name: Contribute
phases.milestone: Run your first 5 discovery calls solo and close your first paid deal.

phases.name: Lead
phases.milestone: Hit your first full quota target and contribute one piece of competitive intelligence the team uses.

goals.title: Pass internal product certification and ICP / persona quiz
Shadow 6 calls (2 demos, 2 discovery, 2 close) and write a takeaway doc
Build a personalised pitch and demo flow approved by manager
Run 5 discovery calls solo with manager review afterwards
Close your first paid deal end-to-end (sourced or assisted)
Build a working pipeline with at least 3x quota in qualified opps
Hit your first full quota target
Document one piece of competitive intelligence the rest of the team adopts

successDefinition: By Day 90, I'm running my own pipeline, hitting quota, trusted by my SE and CS partners, and the team uses something I've contributed (a positioning angle, a competitive teardown, or a new sequence).

firstWeekActivities.title: Complete product training and internal certification quiz
Shadow 2 demos and 2 discovery calls live
1:1 with manager — agree on activity targets for first 30 days
Set up CRM, sequences, and review existing playbooks
Listen to 10 recorded calls from past wins and losses
